attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Client-side-only JS change to Flow/Bag widget drag-and-drop with nontrivial DOM/id-rewriting logic and no server-side validation, so a bug here could allow disallowed content types to be dropped or corrupt input name/id rewriting (breaking form posts) across all sites using Flow/Bag parts, but it's isolated to admin editor UI and doesn't touch content storage or APIs."}

reason: Client-side-only JS change to Flow/Bag widget drag-and-drop with nontrivial DOM/id-rewriting logic and no server-side validation, so a bug here could allow disallowed content types to be dropped or corrupt input name/id rewriting (breaking form posts) across all sites using Flow/Bag parts, but it's isolated to admin editor UI and doesn't touch content storage or APIs.
